title: CARv1 writer: hand-rolled streaming encoder
description: Implement a minimal CARv1 binary encoder in a new module crates/transit/src/car_writer.rs. No external CBOR or CAR crate needed. CARv1 format: varint(header_len) || CBOR-header || blocks. Each block: varint(cid_len+data_len) || CID-bytes || data. CBOR header hand-encoded: map{version:1, roots:[cid]}. Include LEB128 unsigned varint encoder. No-alloc streaming writes via AsyncWrite.
